operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case table/column names: "building" lowercase, "Institution" capital I, columns "Name", "Street_address", "Years_as_tallest", "Primary_Conference", "Institution_id" — must double-quote and preserve original spelling; case-insensitive lookup.
All PKs are TEXT holding numeric strings ('0','1','10','2'...) — String fuzzer will emit non-numeric strings for PKs, breaking FK joins unless FK fill copies parent values.

FK Institution.building_id -> building.building_id: parent has 8 rows, child 11 rows, child distinct 7 — child has duplicate FK values and one parent row unreferenced; FK fill with replacement is fine.
FK protein.Institution_id -> Institution.Institution_id: child 5 rows, 4 distinct — duplicates present; parent 11 rows.
Founded is REAL but stores whole years as floats (1998.0, 1881.0) — Number fuzzer with scale from 'real' (no args) will produce wide floats, not plausible years.
sequence_length REAL stores integer-valued floats (1584.0) — Number fuzzer will emit fractional values.
divergence_from_human_lineage REAL, values 371.2..937.5 — Number fuzzer range [-10^scale,10^scale] with no args gives huge range.
sequence_identity_to_human_protein TEXT stores percent strings '39%','47%' — String fuzzer adds %-stripped variants and int±1 strings.
Years_as_tallest TEXT stores en-dash ranges '1913–1915' — String fuzzer treats as generic text, will contaminate.
Type column has only 3 distinct values (Private/Public/Tribal) — String fuzzer will generate random strings, losing the enum.
Primary_Conference has literal 'none' string (not NULL) — String fuzzer may generate 'none'-like values.
All columns notnull=0, null_rate=0.0 — no NOT NULL constraints, so TS NULLs from empty parents won't fail inserts; tiny tables (8/11/5 rows) mean original_values sampling k=min(5,len) is small.
operator_ts_expectations: building_id / Institution_id / common_name PKs are TEXT -> String fuzzer: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings of length 0-20, plus contamination; PKs become non-numeric garbage, so queries filtering building_id='0' or Institution_id='1' return empty -> FN.
FK columns filled by copying parent PK values with replacement; since parent PKs are random strings, joins still work but WHERE on literal numeric ids fails -> FN.
Founded REAL -> Number fuzzer scale from 'real' (no args => scale 0? args empty) draws uniform in [-10^scale,10^scale]; years like 1998 not reproduced -> range predicates on Founded miss -> FN.

Enrollment INT -> Number fuzzer int perturbation ±1/±2 around elements; plausible-ish but random fresh draws in [-10^scale,10^scale] with scale from 'int' (no args) -> huge ints -> FN on Enrollment thresholds.
Height_feet/Floors INT -> Number fuzzer; small tables so elements dominate (p=0.2 fresh), values near originals ±1/±2 -> moderate.
Type/Primary_Conference/Team TEXT -> String fuzzer random strings; equality predicates on 'Private'/'Public' fail -> FN; GROUP BY Type yields many singleton groups -> FP on aggregate comparisons.
sequence_identity_to_human_protein '39%' -> String fuzzer adds '39' (%-stripped) and '40','38' (int±1) plus random strings; LIKE '%39%' may match spuriously -> FP.
Years_as_tallest en-dash ranges -> String fuzzer contamination (prefix/suffix/drop char) may create values matching LIKE patterns -> FP.
Tiny tables (5-11 rows): choose_table_sizes rand_lin gives 30+int(u*200) rows, so generated tables are much larger than originals -> cardinality-sensitive queries (COUNT, DISTINCT) diverge -> FP/FN.
String fuzzer's int-like ±1 expansion on numeric-string PKs ('0'->'1','-1') may accidentally create plausible ids -> occasional TP.
Number fuzzer list_max quirk (overwrites with full-range max) means even with elements, fresh draws span full range -> implausible Founded/Enrollment -> FN.
Date/Time/Bool/Bit fuzzers unused here (no such declared types) — no date-template quirks.
